purpose: Find a simpler holding rule with transparent turnover and fee effects
periodic_rules: Same quintile target as baseline. First day enters, then every 2 or 5 days; hold original units between trades. Report every starting phase at baseline fees.
rank_mean_rules: Compute each day's percentile rank among that day's finite scores (higher is better). Average the latest 3 or 5 available calendar days including the signal day, with expanding warmup. Select only signal-day eligible names; average over finite ranks in the window. Then equal-weight top and bottom 20% each day.
scope: Same frozen factor, inputs, 400 holding intervals, execution/valuation and initial/terminal trading costs as existing comparison.
report: All candidate results, all periodic phases, and calendar-2025/calendar-2026 slices. Select 3-day rank averaging for explanation if useful; do not search additional parameters to obtain a positive result.
status: Retrospective development on a previously viewed period; these results are not independent strategy-selection OOS.
